recommendations.black_ice::player_fail_finale_instakill: Run the fatal mission transition once. Keep missionfailed, flag_player_dying_on_rig, shared fog/dvar and world earthquake side effects in the mission coordinator; only camera, overlay, rumble and player-link work can be player-contextualized.
recommendations.black_ice::ascend_logic: Keep one ascend coordinator for ropes, allies, flags, launch state and shared rigs. A future second-player handler needs its own player rig, view clamp and input readiness, synchronized to the same timeline; do not duplicate the global trigger or ally choreography.
recommendations.black_ice::event_player_turns_key: Treat the flare-stack console as a single-owner interaction. Pass the chosen player explicitly to the animation/control helper, but set the console flag and play shared audio/mission notifications once.
recommendations.carrier::knockback_hesh: Keep the Sparrow knockdown/slide and slow-motion timeline as one mission event. A second-player rig may only be added as a synchronized actor after native client creation; never start another global slow-motion/autosave/flag sequence.
recommendations.carrier::cut_the_rope: Keep the rope trigger entity (self/var_0) as the interaction owner and add an explicit player parameter only if refactoring. Lock the rope to one player; store active_rope and control/inventory restore state on that player.
recommendations.carrier::victory_choppers_land: Run the landing/victory/save coordinator once. If a second local player exists, add a separate actor rig to the same animation timeline rather than duplicating the mission end and autosave.
recommendations.cornered::gun_down_trigger_internal: Keep gun-down activation shared and single-owner while weapon inventory/ammo snapshots remain per-player. level.has_hidden_weapon_equipped and ammoCounterHide are shared state and cannot safely be toggled by two concurrent handlers.
recommendations.cornered::fall_player: Split the sequence into one world-collapse coordinator and per-player camera/control/rig handlers. Keep global flags, fall path, world gravity, physics explosions, autosave and mission failure single-shot; make fall_arms_and_legs and player view/weapon state player-indexed only after native Local Client 1 is proven.
recommendations.cornered::upload_virus_enter: Treat the device, upload completion, dynamic DOF and device animation as one shared interaction. Track one interaction owner and restore that player's weapons/view state; review level.allow_fire and dvars because they are level/global side effects that can affect P2.

engineering_decisions: Use one mission event coordinator plus explicit per-player handlers.
Keep mission flags, autosave, mission failure, world physics, slow motion and shared objectives single-shot.
Use a single-owner lock for shared rope, console, weapon-hide and virus-upload interactions.
Keep Logan as Player 1 and Hesh as an NPC; do not convert or spawn a second Hesh.
Only bind per-player state after native PS3 Local Client 1 and independent controller mapping are verified.
limitations: Static GSC review only; no FastFile was modified.
No mission GSC patch was compiled into retail FastFiles.
No PPU runtime dumps or physical PS3 input logs have been supplied.
This report does not prove a native second local client or playable Campaign co-op.
